newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Wednesday, issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and they are annual percentage rates.
The central bank does not post volumes.
Traders said trading volume continued to shrink today because non-bank institutions, which used to be major borrowers on the market, have borrowed less and less recently.
"Most of these institutions have sufficent funds, with no treasury bonds maturing in the recent time," said one analyst. "The weak domestic A share market also reduced their demand."
"Trading was dull today, partly because of weak sentiment on the A share market," said a second trader. "The rates are likely to consolidate around current levels in the short term."
Traders said short-term financial centres, money brokerages run by the central bank, acted as the major borrowers today.
